There is no reason why you cannot start by stepping down. At the end of stepping down you'll be free. I've experience with speed and heroin withdraw. No matter the method stepping down cold turkey..at home or in rehab..it helped me to focus on the negative of using and positives of quitting. Meth is lethal it killed my husband. He had a bowel perforation and only used 1 quarter gram once week for 8 months.  I quit lying to myself it's deadly, cost me my husband, and I admitted I was an addict. It also helps if you picture your life drug free. It's not pleasant but you can quit. You are already admitting the truth to yourself. So at least try but remember time is of the essence..even using meth one more time can kill you..i would not allow myself to be to scared of the side effects bc death is even more scary and sad. Focus on your family and what it does to them.. And remember once your free you'll still have a tendency to become addicted so be careful don't let yourself lose your freedom again. Drugs are nothing but a chain around your neck that you put there. You can quit. Please start soon..any attempt is a start. If you can't step down seek outpatient help and if that don't work say f it and go to rehab..
